title: Finite constructibility and normalized finite presentations
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $D=(k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an algebraic closure $\Omega$ and an embedding $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $X_0$ be separated and of finite type over $k_0$, and let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$, $i_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be complementary open and closed immersions [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Their base changes, specified coefficient functors and mate predicates are those of [def-sf-open-closed-weil-mate-data]. Then (∀ n : ℕ, sfFiniteOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l E j₀ i₀ n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, sfFinitePresentationOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l E j₀ i₀ n). Its notions and specified comparisons use [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], [def-sf-integral-open-operations], [def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data], [def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data], [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data], [def-zl-common-stage-weil-shriek], [def-zl-frobenius-compact-support-comparison], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-adjunction], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction], [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data], [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

proof.text: Use the geometric-Frobenius automorphisms and their inverse pullbacks to obtain finite intrinsic equivalences. The finite immersion constructibility interval preserves the two restrictions and the closed image; finite open extension preserves the bounded support interval. Restrict the ordinary adjunctions. The intrinsic inverse and forward mates are invertible by the equivalence mate lemmas. Their unit/counit identities follow from the mate correspondence. Conjugate the intrinsic pullback squares by sfFiniteRingPullIso. The mates of these comparisons identify both adjoints and their units and counits. Pasting mates gives both three-factor transport equations, including identity and empty immersions.

theorem sf_openClosed_weil_finite_stage
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (_ιE : E →ₐ[Padic l] Ω)
    {X₀ U₀ Z₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U₀.hom] [QuasiCompact U₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₀.hom]
    (j₀ : U₀ ⟶ X₀) (i₀ : Z₀ ⟶ X₀)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] [IsClosedImmersion i₀.left]
    (_hij : Set.range i₀.left.base = (Set.range j₀.left.base)ᶜ) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, sfFiniteOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l E j₀ i₀ n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, sfFinitePresentationOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l E j₀ i₀ n)
